about: Text-free photographed props every chapter gets as images.prop_<family>_<name> (chapter.mjs prepareAssets: generated once by imagegen, cached by prompt) when its code names a member (prop_trace_blood) or a family (K.props(images, 'trace', n)). Many things of one kind on screen (cases, samples, records) take different members of a family, never one picture copied (repeatErrors), and never bare code shapes in their place. Add members and families as films need them.

families.use: RETIRED for new films (2026-10-26, CONVERGE-20261026 §3.5; the user: 不要红底的文字 / 不要加字描边阴影 下面或者侧面的红线 / 不要撕纸): words stand on no plate, emphasis is colour and size (lessons L91, L93, L75). Kept only so the films made before keep their pictures: the plate under a word, a tag or a chip of an older card page (labels.mjs, the white paper multiplied by the colour); an eva-lettered page strips it to its words in red. Never ask for it in a new plan or chapter. Was: the plate under a word, a tag or a chip (錯/對, 有推理, an annotation on a photo, a figure's board): its outline and paper come from one of these, its colour from the film's style (labels.mjs: the white paper multiplied by the colour, cut to its own edge); neighbouring tags take different members; never a flat code rectangle (cardgeometry.mjs flatPlateErrors; user 2026-10-23: 这种设计的挺丑 为什么不能生图来做) — no torn paper and no paper strips (user 2026-10-25: 之后也不要这种纸条撕纸设计什么的了): the torn strip and the masking tape were taken out
